stories.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools with strict input models, required/optional fields, defaults, and standardized 422 validation errors with field-level detail. Schemas must align exactly with Anthropic tool_use structure (name + JSON input payload) and existing tool_models modules.

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement routing engine enforcing explicit allowlist (config-driven), strict schema-to-tool binding, input validation via Pydantic, payload normalization, and rejection of unknown tools. Emit structured debug logs (tool name, validation outcome, latency, rejection reason). Provide deterministic error taxonomy (validation_error, unknown_tool, execution_error) and normalized response envelope for all outcomes.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Implement controlled chat history injection with token-aware truncation (prioritize most recent messages), role filtering (user/assistant/system), ordering guarantees, and mandatory de-identification via consent_service prior to tool execution.

stories.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
stories.description: Integrate router into FastAPI main loop: parse Anthropic tool_use blocks, invoke routing, enforce timeouts, handle malformed payloads gracefully, and normalize outputs (including errors) into Anthropic-compatible tool_result blocks to maintain agent loop continuity.

stories.title: Tool Routing and Validation Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure, dispatch correctness, chat history injection, malformed tool_use blocks, unknown tools, partial inputs, and edge cases across all tool types.
